item.group_name: Composed pieces (several tools, one finished thing)
item.title: Choose My Thumbnail Headline

turns.text: Make a 16:9 YouTube thumbnail for my video about quitting late-night scrolling and sleeping better. Invent a tired-looking person for it and choose a punchy three-word headline yourself. Big face, easy to read on a phone.

item.tests: Tests choosing suitable unspecified headline wording and delivering a complete face-and-text thumbnail without unnecessary clarification.

answer_sheet.Video topic: Quitting late-night scrolling to sleep better.
answer_sheet.Person: Invent a tired-looking person; age, appearance and placement are your call.
answer_sheet.Platform and size: One 16:9 YouTube thumbnail; free-tier resolution is fine.

must_haves: One finished 16:9 thumbnail with a large, visibly tired-looking human face.
A completed headline of exactly three words appears in the image, not placeholder text.
The headline clearly relates to stopping late-night scrolling or improving sleep.
The headline is high-contrast and readable at phone-thumbnail size.
The face and headline remain unobstructed, with neither cropped awkwardly at the image edges.

turns.agent:
Magic Hour refused the generation because your account doesn’t have enough credits, so no thumbnail was created.

The design is ready: **16:9**, an invented tired-looking adult’s **big face** beside a glowing phone, with **“STOP SCROLLING TONIGHT”** in huge yellow-and-white lettering on a dark navy background—easy to read on a phone.

approvals.name: generate_image

style.prompt: Create a polished 16:9 YouTube thumbnail about quitting late-night phone scrolling and sleeping better. Invent a fictional adult person, no real person likeness. Strong simple composition optimized to read on a small phone: enormous expressive tired face on the RIGHT half, face filling most of the image height, obvious sleepy eyes, under-eye circles, messy hair, weary relatable expression, holding a smartphone near their cheek with cool blue screen glow. Dark navy bedroom background, subtle pillow, almost no clutter. LEFT half reserved for very large extra-bold condensed sans-serif headline in exactly three words, stacked in three lines: STOP / SCROLLING / TONIGHT. Exact spelling, no additional text. STOP and TONIGHT in bright warm yellow, SCROLLING in white, thick dark outline and shadow, huge clear lettering with generous separation and safe margins. High contrast warm yellow typography against near-black navy background, cinematic realistic portrait, crisp clean graphic design, highly visible face and phone, emotional and punchy rather than scary. A tiny crossed-out moonlit phone symbol can reinforce stopping the habit if space permits, but keep layout very simple. No logos, no watermark, no small text.
